description: How the brand's customer roles relate to each other: advisors serving shoppers and enrolling members, members replenishing routines, launch operators equipping the front line with compliant claims, and the preference signals that flow back into new collections.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Buying routines, gifts, and refills across channels

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Advising, serving, enrolling, and recovering customers day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Refunds, exchanges, and goodwill on service recovery

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Product claims, launch knowledge, and preference signals

relations.name: Advises shoppers on scents and routines
relations.description: Guides shoppers through scent discovery, routine building, and gift composition in boutiques, travel retail, and partner counters, turning brand knowledge into a premium assisted sale.

relations.name: Buys routines and gifts through the store
relations.description: Purchases body care, home fragrance, and composed gift sets at the counter or online with store pickup, paying through the omnichannel checkout the store operates.

relations.name: Enrolls shoppers into membership and refills
relations.description: Signs shoppers up for the loyalty program and refill formats at the moment of sale, turning one-off gift buyers into members with a replenishable routine.

relations.name: Replenishes through the preferred store or online
relations.description: Places repeat refill and replenishment orders with the preferred boutique or webshop, redeeming member rewards and switching to refill formats where sensible.

relations.name: Equips advisors with launch and claims knowledge
relations.description: Delivers launch briefings, ingredient stories, and approved sustainability claims so advisors sell new collections confidently without overstating what a product does.

relations.name: Publishes compliant product claims
relations.description: Puts regulator-proof ingredient, allergen, and sustainability claims on packaging and product pages so shoppers can trust what they buy for themselves and as gifts.

relations.name: Feeds refill and scent preference signals
relations.description: Generates repeat-purchase, refill-adoption, and scent-preference data that launch and merchandising operators use to shape new collections and refill formats.

relations.name: Returns and requests service recovery
relations.description: Brings back damaged gifts, wrong shipments, or reactions to a product through the store or service channel, expecting a smooth cross-channel resolution.

relations.name: Refunds and compensates service issues
relations.description: Issues refunds, exchanges, or goodwill gestures on failed deliveries and product issues, keeping the premium relationship intact after a bad moment.
